review.notes: Full review. All 12 sampled targets (1.0-5.2) recomputed with degenerate cases, Levi's six-lemma route checked step by step; no false statement found. 14 source locators read in the four arXiv texts (all at the stated pages, one misdescribed); Levi 1955 and Boltyanski-Martini-Soltan not read. 41 library declarations opened at the pins. Suggested.lean elaborates with 11 sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe closes none. Dependency check: 0 problems. Automatic checks all passed. The one finding (P2) is that the routes of 1.2, 4.1 and 4.2 follow the proofs of the Aiger-Har-Peled-Zuzic preprint clause by clause in its notation; alternative routes are given.
